headline: Indian envoy briefs PM Modi after talks with Bangladesh leadership
summary: High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi met with PM Narendra Modi in Delhi following his first official meeting with Bangladesh's PM Tarique Rahman.
details: Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh, Dinesh Trivedi, met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Delhi on Tuesday, August 11. This meeting followed his first official encounter with Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman in Dhaka on Monday.

The discussions in Delhi focused on strengthening the long-standing and multifaceted relationship between India and Bangladesh, with Trivedi seeking guidance from PM Modi on how to further advance the partnership.

Following the meeting in Dhaka, Bangladesh's Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman expressed hope that the Indian government now understands Bangladesh's perspective and will not undermine any pillar of the state.
A statement from the Prime Minister's press wing noted that important bilateral issues were discussed, and Bangladesh hopes that India will expedite the process of repatriating Sheikh Hasina.
Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi described his discussions with PM Tarique Rahman as 'very good' and stated that both nations are now looking forward.
caption:
From Dhaka to Delhi in 24 hours: Indian envoy briefs PM Modi after high-level talks with Bangladesh's leadership.

Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh, Dinesh Trivedi, met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Delhi on Tuesday, August 11. This meeting followed his first official encounter with Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman in Dhaka on Monday.

The discussions in Delhi focused on strengthening the long-standing and multifaceted relationship between India and Bangladesh, with Trivedi seeking guidance from PM Modi on how to further advance the partnership.

Following the meeting in Dhaka, Bangladesh's Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman expressed hope that the Indian government now understands Bangladesh's perspective and will not undermine any pillar of the state.

A statement from the Prime Minister's press wing noted that important bilateral issues were discussed, and Bangladesh hopes that India will expedite the process of repatriating Sheikh Hasina.

Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi described his discussions with PM Tarique Rahman as 'very good' and stated that both nations are now looking forward.

headline: Actor Khairul Basar injured in Thailand during drama shoot
summary: The actor and a cinematographer were seriously injured in a scooter accident on Koh Lan island while returning from a hill shoot.
details: Actor Khairul Basar and cinematographer Mehedi Rony were seriously injured in a scooter accident on Koh Lan island, Thailand, on Tuesday.
The accident occurred around 4:30 PM Bangladesh time as they were returning from a shoot on top of a hill.
According to Basar, the scooter lost control while descending the hill, causing both of them to fall immediately.
Basar sustained injuries to his chest and knees, stating that he is currently having difficulty walking.
Members of the shooting team rescued the pair and transported them to a hospital in Pattaya for medical treatment.
Due to the the physical condition of the actor, the shooting of the drama has been cancelled.
caption:
A drama shoot in Thailand turns into a crisis as actor Khairul Basar and a cinematographer are seriously injured in a scooter accident.

Actor Khairul Basar and cinematographer Mehedi Rony were seriously injured in a scooter accident on Koh Lan island, Thailand, on Tuesday.

The accident occurred around 4:30 PM Bangladesh time as they were returning from a shoot on top of a hill.

According to Basar, the scooter lost control while descending the hill, causing both of them to fall immediately.

Basar sustained injuries to his chest and knees, stating that he is currently having difficulty walking.

Members of the shooting team rescued the pair and transported them to a hospital in Pattaya for medical treatment.

Due to the the physical condition of the actor, the shooting of the drama has been cancelled.
